dogecoin.text: I have yet see any logic on how buying a #DogeX nft in any way helps the Dogecoin price?  You can't buy them with Doge.  You can't mint them with Doge. Nothing about them drives any part of the Doge market.  I want to see crypto thrive as a whole but who benefits? Not #Dogecoin
